premises.text: Breach cost, not occurrence, is the residual risk firms manage via encryption
premises.evidence_span: no longer a question of whether a breach will occur, but rather what the cost of this breach will be

premises.text: Data stays encrypted at rest, transit, and in-memory DB storage
premises.evidence_span: data remains encrypted, addressed, in transit, and in memory at the database storage

premises.text: Private search returns data to the app for decryption only there
premises.evidence_span: fetch them back to the application in a private way, and only there the data gets decrypted

premises.text: Requires no application changes and never reveals the key
premises.evidence_span: The key never gets revealed, and no application changes are required

premises.text: Real-time Docker encryption plus dynamic re-encryption after queries
premises.evidence_span: that data set got dynamically re-encrypted

premises.text: Oblivious RAM with differential privacy enables efficient secure indexes
premises.evidence_span: oblivious RAM, with differential privacy in order to ensure an efficient and secure indexing

value.text: Usable never-decrypt security for cloud databases and analytics
value.evidence_span: We are a private search engine on top of encrypted data

causal_links.evidence_span: Encryption is the most effective measure in mitigating this risk

notes: Bank IoT demo treated as illustration of analytics-on-ciphertext, not a separate vertical premise. Market $1.6B excluded.
